The gate required the evidence commit to EQUAL the closing commit, which no ordinary workflow could satisfy: closure evidence lives at a tracked path, so writing it dirties the tree (G4-13), committing it advances HEAD past the evidence (G4-12), and re-pointing the evidence advances HEAD again — a tracked commit cannot contain its own SHA. Replaced by provenance, NOT by relaxation: the evidence names an EVIDENCE SUBJECT HEAD, that subject must be an ANCESTOR of the current governance head, and every path changed between them must be closure-tail metadata. One substantive path changing after the subject still makes the evidence stale. The closure-tail allowlist is an explicit six-entry list (phase record, closure evidence, reports, reports index, current-state, session) that excludes the plan, all source, validators, schemas and architecture documents, and refuses traversal. Ancestry and the changed-path split are computed from git in the deriving layer, never read from the record; a git failure yields a sentinel substantive entry so an unreadable diff cannot read as 'nothing changed'.
